the assessment of language revitalization activities is a complex task that requires the consideration of a number of factors that are often overlooked by researchers and practitioners alike.

language revitalization efforts should be guided by a set of key principles that include: (i) the need to understand the nature and extent of the language shift that is being reversed; (ii) the need to identify and understand the language shift factors that are being reversed; (iii) the need to assess and understand the extent of language shift in terms of its effects on the community; and (iv) the need to evaluate the extent of language revitalization in terms of its impact on the community.
